title: Week's best: £17.99 Lego City advent calendar, a £29.99 Ring doorbell and LG's B6 OLED at its low
description: This week's strongest UK deals still live on Friday: Lego from £17.99, a £32 heated airer, a £29.99 Ring doorbell and two TVs at their recent lows.
intro:
It's Friday, so here are the week's best deals that are still live, checked again this morning. We've also added a few new ones. The Lego deals from earlier in the week have mostly held, and the Millennium Falcon has dropped another 50p. Two TVs are already at or below their six-month lows, five weeks before Black Friday.

Some deals from earlier in the week are missing because we couldn't confirm today's price, so we've left them out. That includes the Oral-B iO9 and the Silentnight heated throw. We've also published two new guides today: [Ring doorbell Black Friday deals](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [TV Black Friday deals](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/). Prices were checked on 23 October.

deals.name: Lego City Advent Calendar 2026 (60510)
deals.note: Still the cheapest anywhere we've checked. The next best price is about £21.50 delivered from smaller toy shops, and Lego charges £22.99 plus delivery. Buy now, because advent calendars sell out rather than get cheaper.

deals.name: Lego Star Wars Millennium Falcon (75375)
deals.note: A third off the £74.99 RRP, and 50p less than on Tuesday. Joybuy matches it. It's the smaller display Falcon, not the £735 UCS one, so it makes a good gift for a Star Wars fan who builds.

deals.name: Lego Harry Potter Hogwarts Castle and Grounds (76419)
deals.note: 22% off and about £16 cheaper than any other shop we checked. It was £110 earlier in the week, so it's not quite the best price. It's still a good one for a big Christmas present. See our [Lego Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/) for target prices.

deals.name: Ring Wired Video Doorbell 2K (2nd Gen)
deals.note: Half the price Ring charges itself (£59.99). It needs existing doorbell wiring, so it's best if you're replacing a wired bell. To get recordings you'll need a Ring plan, from £4.99 a month. Details in our [Ring doorbell guide](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Dunelm Heated Ladder Airer (90W)
deals.note: Still £8 off. At 90W it costs roughly 2–3p an hour to run at current electricity rates, far less than a tumble dryer. A good buy now that it's too cold to dry washing outside.

deals.name: LG B6 55-inch OLED TV (OLED55B65LA, 2026)
deals.note: Matches its lowest price in six months, according to Which? data. LG's entry-level OLED has the same perfect blacks as pricier models, though it's less bright. It may drop further on Black Friday, but this is a fair price if you need a TV now.

deals.name: Hisense U7S 55-inch Mini LED TV (55U7STUK, 2026)
deals.note: About £200 below the lowest price Which? recorded in the past six months. Richer Sounds matches it, with £100 cashback from Hisense. A bright TV that suits living rooms with lots of daylight. Check the code carefully, as the 'U7S PRO' is a different model.

body:
## Worth waiting for?

**Buy now:** the Lego City advent calendar and the Millennium Falcon are at their lowest prices, and the advent calendar is already starting to sell out. The heated airer is a useful buy before the weather turns properly cold.

**Fine to buy now, might drop:** the LG B6 OLED and the Hisense U7S. Both are at good prices already. Most other OLEDs are still £100 to £300 above last Black Friday, so check our [TV Black Friday guide](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/) before buying a bigger model.

**Wait:** most Ring doorbells are still at full price at Ring and Currys. The newest Battery Video Doorbell 2K is £79.99, while its predecessor was £39.99 last Black Friday. Our [Ring guide](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/) has the target prices.

For everything else, see [Black Friday 2026: what to buy now, what to wait for, and the traps to avoid](/spotlight/black-friday-2026-buy-now-or-wait/) and [every Black Friday guide](/black-friday/).
